name: AI Helmets
author: Sedz
description: Set AI drivers' helmets. Import helmets of your own or use helmets from the in game database.

options.label: Team helmet after a move
options.description: Automatically use the new team's helmet after a swap, either a base game helmet or user uploaded. Turning this off means you will need to select each driver's helmet manually.

options.label: Verbose log
options.description: Log every Team HQ check to swofty/loader.log, not only changes.
